reason: A DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that adds four Catppuccin color themes, applies interface-level visual styling, and remembers the selected theme per browser.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加四种 Catppuccin 配色主题，并在浏览器中记住用户选择。
summaries.en: Adds four Catppuccin color themes to DeepSeek Harness and remembers the selected theme in the browser.

capabilities: Registers four Catppuccin appearance themes in DeepSeek Harness
Changes interface colors, accents, and visual states when selected
Stores the selected theme per browser using localStorage
Restores the built-in appearance when Default is selected
